prompt: Which of these is a famous place to visit in Lesotho?
explanation: Maletsunyane Falls at Semonkong is one of the two places we'd love to visit in Lesotho. One of Africa's highest single-drop waterfalls, Maletsunyane plunges nearly 200 metres into a gorge.
